title: Wall Mount Shower Basket 18.75-Inch Solid Brass Wire, Oval Combination | Sea Foam Green | Allied Brass
body_html:
Upgrade your shower storage with an oval combination basket crafted from solid brass and ventilated wire for drainage in a space-saving wall mount design in Sea Foam Green, which captures the tranquil essence of ocean-inspired design, bringing soft, natural color to coastal and contemporary spaces.

  • Sea Foam Green transforms this essential into a conversation piece
  • Choose from 28 designer finishes to match the rest of your bathroom
  • Clean installation: Concealed screw mounting hardware for a finished look.
  • Finish flexibility: Available in a wide variety of designer finish options, including statement colors.
  • Warranty: Limited Lifetime Warranty.

Specs

  • Category: Basket
  • Product: Oval Combination Shower Basket
  • Style: Traditional (coordinates with classic bath accessories and heritage bathroom fixtures)
  • Mounting type: Wall mount
  • Dimensions: 18.75-Inch L x 4.13-Inch W x 2.25-Inch H
  • Projection: 4.13-Inch
  • Weight: 4.8 lb
  • Included: Basket and all installation hardware
  • Assembly required: No
